appearances.snippet: came her exclusive report that I was potentially paid half a million dollars by the Southern Poverty Law Center. ... To communicate David Duke talking points, was the SPLC paying Candace Owens 500k a year to plagiarize David Duke?

verification.notes: Current coverage reproduces Loomers question alleging that the SPLC may have paid Owens 500,000 dollars per year to plagiarize David Duke, and the source episode quotes the same allegation. This verifies that Loomer made the allegation, not that any payment occurred; no evidence of payment was found.
